# Referrer-Policy & Permissions-Policy Checker

> Check your site's Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers for unsafe-url, invalid syntax and wildcard camera or microphone access. Nothing uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/referrer-permissions-policy-check/)
